intent: Eight individually authored appearance tasks distinguish surfaces, source materials, adjective senses, spatial relations and capability scope.

transfer.stem: Which report follows the display notes?
transfer.passage:
A visit to the makers’ display
Our club arranged a small display beside the windows. A handsome wooden cabinet held the work. The cabinet itself was attractive; the label did not describe a man. Above it hung a beautiful pattern made from tiny pieces of glass.
One photograph showed wet stones looking shiny in the sun, with a pretty flower growing between them. A second photograph showed a brass handle before polishing. Its surface looked dull. The notes did not show what happened after polishing.
On a low table stood a cute toy robot. Lin demonstrated a wave with one arm. The note said it could wave one arm; it did not list all the other actions it could or could not do. Beside it was a bag with an ugly stain on its front. The description referred to the stain, not a person.
At the last window, our teacher said, “What a lovely view!” We looked at the garden outside. She was praising the view from that window, not predicting the weather for every day.

options.text: The brass handle looked dull before polishing; the robot could wave one arm; the stain was on the front of the bag.
The brass handle became dull only after polishing; the robot could wave one arm; the stain was on the front of the bag.
The brass handle looked dull before polishing; waving one arm was the only action the robot could perform; the stain was on the front of the bag.
The brass handle looked dull before polishing; the robot could wave one arm; the teacher guaranteed good weather every day.

answer.display: The brass handle looked dull before polishing; the robot could wave one arm; the stain was on the front of the bag.

explanation.strategy: 先核对抛光前后的时间，再区分一项能力和全部能力。

steps.text: 把手在抛光前显得暗淡；机器人能挥一只手臂。
steps.reason: before polishing给时间。can wave one arm说明会这个动作，没有only。

steps.text: 污渍在包正面；老师赞美的是窗外景色。
steps.reason: front保留位置；What a lovely view!不保证每天好天气。

distractors.reason: 会挥一只手臂不等于只会这一项动作。
赞美眼前景色不等于保证每天好天气。

explanation.pitfall: 只抓住同一个形容词，却漏掉时间、对象或没有依据的only。
